# Results — Study 762 (Vegas-Gaming-Win)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The gaming-sector folklore —
**rising Las Vegas Strip gross gaming revenue (GGR) momentum leads a run in the casino
stocks** — tested on the monthly **Strip-GGR** tape (a hardcoded, clearly-labelled
approximate reconstruction of the Nevada Gaming Control Board "Las Vegas Strip" line, since
the NGCB PDFs aren't machine-fetchable in this build) against an equal-weight **casino basket**
(MGM, LVS, WYNN, CZR, BYD, PENN; yfinance, total-return adjusted). We split forward
1/3/6/12-month basket returns into months when GGR momentum is **rising** vs **falling**,
compare each to the unconditional base rate, and add a Welch *t*, a placebo null, a lead/lag
scan and a tradable timing overlay. Offline & deterministic; run `python examples/verify.py`
to reproduce every number.*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| GGR tape | Nevada GCB "Las Vegas Strip" GGR (US$ millions); **hardcoded monthly reconstruction**, annual sums matched to published Strip totals |
| Equity tape | yfinance daily adjusted closes — equal-weight **MGM/LVS/WYNN/CZR/BYD/PENN** (total-return adjusted), month-end sampled |
| Window | 2002-02-28 → 2025-06-30 (**281** months; **23.3** years) |
| Signal | GGR momentum = trailing-12-month GGR sum vs **3 months** prior; **RISING** when > 0 |
| Entry / costs | **1-month execution lag** (the month-*t* GGR print is released ~5 weeks later, acted on at the next month-end close); 10 bps one-way per switch on the overlay |

> **Reconstruction caveat (named on the Signal axis).** The NGCB publishes the Strip GGR
> monthly, but the report is a PDF we can't fetch here, so the tape is a **hardcoded
> approximate reconstruction** whose *annual* sums track the published Strip totals
> (~$6.6B/yr pre-COVID, the 2020 closure, the record ~$8.8B of 2023–24) with a plausible
> seasonal shape — public and faithful in aggregate, but **not** the settled month-by-month
> print. Two more caveats travel with the stamp: the basket is a **surviving** set of listed
> operators (it omits names that restructured/were acquired — Caesars 2015–17, Station,
> Pinnacle, Isle — a mild upward tilt on realised return), and casino equities are **high-β**
> (the basket compounds at ~23%/yr with a Sharpe near 0.5, so its return is mostly the
> gaming-sector beta, not any GGR-timing skill).

## The signal — forward basket returns when GGR-momentum is RISING vs the base rate

1-month execution lag; the base column is *all* months. The believers say RISING GGR
momentum should **lift** the forward return; Welch *t* compares the RISING-set mean to the
unconditional mean (a real leading signal ⇒ **significantly positive** *t*). The placebo *p*
is the share of 20,000 random same-size month draws whose mean forward return is **at least**
the RISING set's (i.e. as bullish or more).

| horizon | n rising | rising mean | falling mean | base mean | rising up-rate | base up-rate | Welch *t* | placebo *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 1-month  | 185 | **+1.66%** | +2.31% | +1.88% | 59% | 57% | **−0.20** | 0.572 |
| 3-month  | 183 | **+5.61%** | +5.16% | +5.46% | 66% | 62% | **+0.09** | 0.458 |
| 6-month  | 181 | **+11.51%** | +12.36% | +11.80% | 64% | 65% | **−0.10** | 0.539 |
| 12-month | 181 | **+21.76%** | +31.91% | +25.05% | 66% | 69% | **−0.72** | 0.810 |

Read it carefully. There is **no bullish tilt** at any horizon — the RISING-GGR forward mean
sits *below* the base rate at three of four horizons (at 12 months **+21.8% vs +25.1%**), and
the up-rate is *lower*, not higher. The most extreme Welch *t* is **−0.72** (12-month) with a
placebo *p* of **0.81** — the wrong sign for the folklore and nowhere near significance. The
"buy casinos when Strip revenue accelerates" tilt is **absent-to-mildly-contrarian**.

## The decisive test — do the stocks move first?

The pitch is that GGR **leads**. So we scan the correlation of GGR momentum at *t* against the
basket return over `[t+L, t+L+1]`. A genuine leading signal shows its strongest *positive*
correlation at a **positive** lead (GGR moves first, the stocks rise later).

| lead *L* (months) | −6 | −4 | −2 | 0 | +2 | +4 | +6 |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| corr(GGR-mom, fwd basket) | **+0.07** | +0.05 | −0.07 | −0.11 | −0.10 | −0.09 | −0.07 |

The only **positive** correlation lives at **negative** leads (peak **+0.07 at L = −6**): GGR
momentum today lines up with a basket move **~half a year in its past**. On the leading side
(L > 0, where a true early signal would live) the correlation is **negative** at every lead.
The casino equities — liquid, forward-looking, analyst-covered — **turn first**; the monthly
GGR print, released five weeks after the fact, is a **coincident-to-lagging echo**. That is
the core of the "leading signal? — Not supported" stamp.

## Tradability — "own the casino basket when GGR momentum is rising" overlay

Hold the basket when GGR momentum is rising, sit in cash when falling (one-month lag; 10 bps
per switch, turnover one-way × NAV). Sharpe is excess-of-zero (the cash leg earns 0 here — a
conservative, labelled simplification).

| book | ann. mean | ann. Sharpe | switches |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| buy-and-hold basket | **+23.0%** | **0.49** | — |
| overlay, gross | +13.5% | 0.51 | 11 |
| overlay, net @ 10 bps | **+13.4%** | **0.50** | 11 |

The overlay **ties** buy-and-hold on Sharpe (**0.50 vs 0.49**) while forfeiting **~10 points
of annual return** (**+13.4% vs +23.0%**). GGR momentum is rising ~66% of the time, so the
rule just spends a third of the tape in cash — trimming exposure, not adding skill. It's the
textbook **less-beta mirage**: the same risk-adjusted return with far less compounding.

## Robustness — window, threshold, and the COVID dependence

| variation | n rising | rising 12m mean | base 12m mean | Welch *t* | placebo *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| momentum **k = 1** | 177 | +23.81% | +25.05% | −0.27 | 0.625 |
| momentum **k = 3** (base) | 181 | +21.76% | +25.05% | **−0.72** | 0.810 |
| momentum **k = 6** | 182 | +19.80% | +25.05% | **−1.15** | 0.924 |
| threshold **> +3%** | 30 | +1.61% | +25.05% | **−4.08** | 0.997 |
| threshold **> +5%** | 12 | −23.35% | +25.05% | **−8.49** | 1.000 |
| **drop COVID** (ex-2020H1..2021H1), 12m | 174 | +22.87% | +25.52% | −0.62 | 0.769 |

Two lessons, both *against* the folklore. (1) The tilt gets **more negative** as the window
slows (k = 6 → *t* = −1.15) — no window makes it bullish. (2) Restrict to the **biggest** GGR
accelerations (> +3% / > +5%) and the sign is emphatically **negative** (*t* = **−4.08** /
**−8.49**): the fastest Strip run-rate surges — the post-COVID 2021–22 boom, the 2004–07 build
— are exactly the tops the casino stocks **sell off from** over the next year. Dropping COVID
leaves the 12-month *t* at **−0.62** — still the wrong sign, still insignificant. The signal is
never bullish and is actively *contrarian* where it fires hardest.

## Synthetic positive control — the engine is faithful

A deterministic monthly GGR + basket-like series with a *planted* link (rising GGR momentum at
*t* **lifts** the *t+1* return by `edge`). The detector + inference must recover a planted edge
and must **not** manufacture significance when the true edge is zero.

| planted edge (monthly) | n rising | rising 1m mean | base 1m mean | Welch *t* | placebo *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **0.00** (no link) | 172 | +0.99% | +0.50% | **+0.76** | 0.178 |
| **+0.05** (large link) | 172 | +5.53% | +3.06% | **+3.70** | 0.000 |

With **no** planted link the test sits at *t* = +0.76 (no false positive, well under 2); a
large planted link drives *t* to **+3.70**. The machinery is unbiased and powered — so the
real-tape *t* of ≈ −0.7 is exactly what an *absent* (or mildly contrarian) GGR→returns edge
looks like through this keyhole, not a broken test.

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** The RISING-GGR forward mean is *below* the base rate at three of four
  horizons (12-month **+21.8% vs +25.1%**), the most extreme Welch *t* is **−0.72** (wrong
  sign, placebo *p* = 0.81), and it never clears the bar at any window — while the biggest
  accelerations are emphatically **contrarian** (*t* = −4.08 at > +3%). There is no bullish
  leading signal; GGR momentum carries no tradable forward information about the casino stocks.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The own-when-rising overlay **ties** buy-and-hold on Sharpe
  (**0.50 vs 0.49**) while giving up **~10 pts/yr** of return (**+13.4% vs +23.0%**). It just
  removes a third of the beta — less exposure, not more skill.
- **Leading signal? — NOT SUPPORTED.** The lead/lag scan's only positive correlation sits at
  **L = −6** (GGR momentum lagging the stocks by ~half a year); at positive leads it's
  negative throughout. The forward-looking casino equities move first; the five-weeks-late GGR
  print echoes them. The whole appeal — *leading* — is the part the data rejects.
